public.title: Rotate List
public.description: The array encodes linked-list values from head to tail. Return the list after moving the last element to the front k times. This value-only adaptation does not require node identity or in-place mutation. Length is 0 to 1000; k is 0 to 1000000; values are integers between -1000 and 1000.
hints: Only k modulo the length changes the result.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Split before the last k modulo n elements and place that suffix first. O(n) time and output space.
